access.note: Nothing here is downloaded or restored at demo start. The objects are read over HTTPS by the query engine; only the partitions a query names are fetched.

tables.name: hvfhv_trips
tables.description: Every high-volume for-hire trip in the window, one row per trip, partitioned by pickup_date. The big table: only the day partitions a query names are read.

tables.name: hvfhv_trips_sample
tables.description: The same rows, hash-sampled 1 in 16 (no RNG), one Parquet file per month. Small enough to scan whole — the table a first question should hit.

tables.name: hvfhv_zone_day
tables.description: Trips, fares, tips, driver pay, miles and shared-ride requests aggregated per pickup zone x day x company. Joins to sample-reference.zones on pu_location_id.

tables.name: hvfhs_companies
tables.description: The TLC HVFHS licence-number lookup (HV0002 Juno, HV0003 Uber, HV0004 Via, HV0005 Lyft), transcribed from the TLC data dictionary.

tables.name: hvfhv_trips_iceberg
tables.description: hvfhv_trips_sample again, as an Apache Iceberg table, so the same rows can be read through the Iceberg path and the Parquet path and compared.

provenance.transform: filter to pickup dates 2023-01-01..2024-12-31, to zone ids 1..265, to non-negative money and distance and a positive trip time, and to a dropoff at or after its pickup; project 11 columns; partition by pickup_date; additionally hash-sample hash(natural key) % 16 = 0 (no RNG) into hvfhv_trips_sample and its Iceberg copy; pre-aggregate per zone/day/company
